title: Chapter 118 The Queen Of The Divine Dynasty
content:
Chapter 118 The Queen Of The Divine Dynasty

However, that was only what he knew.

A powerful person in the realm of the God Emperor, this is the watershed for judging whether a power area has truly reached the top power.

A power without a powerful person in the realm of the God Emperor will eventually become a second-rate power.

A star field extremely far away from the Xuanling Star Field.

The Supreme Star Field.

This is an extremely powerful star field.

It has absolute hegemony in the known star fields.

Its territory is dozens of times that of ordinary star fields.

And there is only one power in the entire Supreme Star Field.

The Divine Dynasty!

An empire so terrifying that it is unimaginable, here, even a powerful person in the realm of the God Emperor must be submissive.

In a palace full of noble atmosphere.

A five-clawed dragon is diving into a pool full of divine liquid and swallowing it.

Dragon sucking water!

"Burp~"

After an unknown amount of time, Ao Qing raised his head and burped, and then stopped.

At this time, a guard in golden armor came to Ao Qing and said respectfully: "Lord Ao Qing, the princess is looking for you."

Hearing this, Ao Qing was stunned.

"My lady, you are looking for me?"

Not daring to hesitate, Ao Qing hurriedly set off.

"My lady, you are looking for me."

Arriving in Lu Xue's palace, Ao Qing said carefully when he saw Lu Xue practicing.

Seeing Ao Qing, Lu Xue slowly opened her eyes.

"You stupid dragon, you only know how to eat!"

Lu Xue said unhappily.

In the days since coming to the Divine Dynasty, Ao Qing has been eating and sleeping.

What is different from before is that Ao Qing spends much less time sleeping than eating.

However, Ao Qing's strength has increased very quickly. At this time, Ao Qing has reached the super-god realm. Looking at the entire star field, there are few rivals.

(God Realm, God King Realm, God Lord Realm, God Lord Realm, God Emperor Realm, Super God Realm, God-breaking Realm, True Self Realm, Mortal Realm, Transmundane Realm)

What's more, Ao Qing is the only five-clawed dragon known so far.

His strength is so terrifying.

Hearing Lu Xue's scolding, Ao Qing had long been accustomed to it, and just smiled and said: "My dear, I am doing this to have better strength to protect you."

Hearing this, Lu Xue snorted and said: "Here, I don't need your protection."

"I'll give you a task."

"My dear, just give me your orders."

Hearing the task, Ao Qing was also a little excited. His strength has become so strong, and he also wants to be cool.

But he will not forget his duty.

That is to protect Lu Xue.

If Lu Xue has any accident, the master will probably skin him alive.

At this time, Lu Xue slowly said: "Go to my mother and tell her that you also want to participate in the battle of Tianlin Star Region."

Hearing this, Ao Qing nodded directly.

"Okay, young lady, I'll go."

"Yes, go ahead."

Then, Ao Qing went straight to the tallest and largest palace without looking back.

Lu Xue shook her head.

Her father was so awesome, but her mother was also so strong.

When she first came to the Divine Dynasty, she was a little shocked. The entire Divine Dynasty was so terrifying.

If there was no father in the Desolate City, it would probably not be enough to face the entire Divine Dynasty.

More importantly, her mother was not as kind as her father.

The Divine Dynasty was either fighting or on the way to fight every day. Now, I don't know how many star regions have surrendered to the Divine Dynasty.

And more of them are united to resist the invasion of the Divine Dynasty.

Lu Xue naturally wouldn't pay too much attention to these.

Could it be that she would go against her mother for those invaded star regions?

This is her own mother. What does the invasion have to do with her?

What bothers her most every day is why she has no worries.

Alas, life is too hard.

"Your Majesty, Ao Qing wants to see you."

An old man came forward and said respectfully.

In the magnificent hall, Yan Lingyun sat on the dragon throne, wearing a wide dragon robe, but her proud figure was still difficult to conceal.

Her phoenix eyes were narrow and long, her eyes were sharp, and her whole person was sharp. Her aura made people in the court dare not look up.

This is the empress of the Divine Dynasty!

Hearing the words of the old man, Yan Lingyun said lightly: "Let him in."

"Yes."

And below, countless civil officials and military generals pondered in their hearts.

Ao Qing.

They knew that it was the pet of the daughter that His Majesty suddenly brought back a few days ago.

And it was a rare five-clawed dragon in the world.

They didn't know much about its strength.

But I think it shouldn't be that strong.

After all, there are too few known dragon masters, and there are almost no Divine Emperors.

That's why they thought Ao Qing was just a pet following Lu Xue.

After a while, Ao Qing slowly walked into the hall.

"Madam."

Yan Lingyun nodded, "Ao Qing, do you have anything to do?"

Hearing this, Ao Qing said, "Madam, let me go to the battle of Tianlin Star Region."

As soon as these words came out, the whole hall was in an uproar.

Tianlin Star Region.

This is a very powerful star region that they are going to take down next.

Even they have to be fully prepared.

Of course, it's not that the strength of Tianlin Star Region can match that of the Divine Dynasty, but because the Divine Dynasty often launches wars, the battle line is too long.

So now there are limited strong men who can be mobilized, and many strong men are guarding the territory.

But even so, the Divine Dynasty could still do it if it wanted to take down a star field.

This is the horror of the Divine Dynasty.

At this time, Yan Lingyun nodded, "Yes."

She naturally knew why Ao Qing came, and that must have been Lu Xue's idea.

Thinking of this, Yan Lingyun couldn't help but raise her mouth slightly.

This daughter is so filial.

"Wang Zhen."

"I'm here!"

Suddenly, a man in golden armor stepped forward and walked forward.

He is the commander of the attack on the Tianlin Star Domain this time, and he has the terrifying strength at the peak of the God Emperor Realm.

"Ao Qing, this time, you can just follow Wang Zhen."

"Okay, mistress, I won't let you down."

Ao Qing nodded.

On the side, Wang Zhen had no expression on his face, but he was a little dissatisfied inside.

Why does Your Majesty want to give yourself a burden? Isn’t this adding difficulty to yourself?

However, he did not dare to say this. In the Divine Court, Yan Lingyun was the real god, and no one dared to disobey her.

"My minister, accept the order."

Wang Zhen responded in a faint voice.

Forget it, at worst, when fighting, just pay more attention to the dragon.

Of course, if you accidentally burp, you won’t blame him.

After all, there is no eyebrow on the battlefield.

Obviously, he was not aware of Ao Qing's strength.

However, it is naturally impossible that no one in the hall knows Ao Qing's strength.

The old man standing not far beside Yan Lingyun is one of them.

At this moment, even he was a little afraid of Ao Qing's strength.

The divine dragon in the super-divine realm.

And it is also a five-clawed dragon. This kind of combat power, if it is included in those super forces, can be regarded as a trump card.

He turned his head and looked at Wang Zhen's indifferent expression again, and the old man shook his head.

Still too young.
